title: FramingPrior
description: What we believed before searching. Authored by Claude at stage 1 and frozen there, because a prior computed after the evidence is in is hindsight in costume — and the confirmation-bias argument the episodes teach is exactly the thing it would break. Every component carries its BASIS: a prior without one is a number somebody made up, and step 9's update would then be arithmetic over an invention. Nothing here is checked against the literature this run finds; the honest check is that it was written first, which is what the approval bundle freezes.

authored_by.description: Under the allocation table the prior is Claude's judgement. A Smart-authored prior would be the transitional authorship this artifact exists to avoid.

prior_level.description: The ladder value step 9 checks the posterior against, ordinally.

stated.description: What is claimed. null means 'nothing is known', which is itself an answer.

basis.description: WHY this is believed, before any of this run's evidence was read.

frozen_at.description: ISO 8601 date, optionally with a time. Pattern-constrained because a non-empty string accepted "today" and "unknown" — and 'written before the search' is the ONE property this artifact has, so a value that names no instant cannot assert it.
